title: Birthdays and Dates
text:
My birthday is in March. It is on the fifteenth of March. My best friend's birthday is in May. We always have a party together.

Today is Monday, the third of June. In June, the weather is warm. We go to the park on Saturdays. I like summer very much.

questions.text: What can we infer about the writer's birthday compared with the friend's birthday?
options: It comes before the friend's birthday
It comes after the friend's birthday
It is on the same day as the friend's birthday

questions.text: How does the writer probably feel about summer?
options: The writer is sad about it
The writer has never seen it

vocabulary.definition: the day each year when a person was born
a social event where people eat, drink and have fun together
the conditions outside, such as sun, rain or temperature

paragraph_translations: Мій день народження у березні. Це п'ятнадцяте березня. День народження мого найкращого друга у травні. Ми завжди святкуємо разом з вечіркою.
Сьогодні понеділок, третє червня. У червні погода тепла. По суботах ми ходимо до парку. Я дуже люблю літо.
